title: AI Helpy for AI Textbook
summary: Elice describes AI textbooks with tailored feedback, language support, and teacher oversight. The chapter does not measure learning gains or teacher time saved.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Elice describes AI textbooks with tailored feedback, language support, and teacher oversight. The chapter does not measure learning gains or teacher time saved. AI textbook platform / pilot reference. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Provide personalized, age-appropriate feedback within school curricula.

ratings.reason: The deployed textbook system provides immediate personalized feedback in five supported languages. This is a direct assistance benefit, without a measured learning gain.
Teachers are intended to save work while providing tailored feedback; the chapter does not report the extent of workload reduction.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use case 3: AI Helpy for AI Textbook

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.

headline: AI Helpy personalizes textbook feedback

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
